Auto Driver Murdered in Hyderabad; Second Killing in 24 Hours

An auto-driver, identified as Rauf, was murdered in Mailardevpally, Hyderabad. This incident marks the second murder in the city within a 24-hour period. Authorities have formed a special team to investigate the killing.
